posts.subject: Advertising apologize
posts.bodyHtml:
Ok DooDoo? Or other Admins I have to say sorry.


Sorry for the stupid advertisement for the Skillkeepers server. I wanted to make a
joke but it seems joking about advertisement isn't welcome. You guys know, I am
a bit stupid sometimes 😄 but I rly rly didnt knew this rule. I hope you can forgive
me for this stupid joke and unban me.


Thx and [sry] again...


TimeZ ♠

Hi TimeZ,


To be honest, you're the 2nd Oxygen. I remember when you was extremely rude and so hostile towards me at the beginning but you guys both changed fast. I understand that you only intended to advertise as a joke, but honestly, advertising 2 times in a row isn't a joke. This is more or less sabotaging the server. However, rest assured that you have become a good guy and I tend to have mercy on people who actually want to change. So, with no further a due, I'll unban you, BUT, note that, the next time you advertise, there will be no discussion.


I hope you have reflected on your actions and you are prepared to become a better person (I expect to see no poor behaviour or rule breaking from now on 😄 😄 😄 )


Have fun playing on our servers again,
Doo Doo


EDIT: Thread closed? [closesnew*]

Well you was advertising when I was on the server and this happend twice, When there was me and Doo Doo and you well know advertisement is not allowed but everyone does mistakes and not everyone is perfect and advertisement is not really a joke when you do it twice, for me you should be unbanned after a time of a week as you showed you'r sincere and you were a nice and cool guy and I respect you but you should be unbanned after a time of 2/4 weeks as that was massive what you have done.
Hope to hear from you soon.


Kind Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.



//EDIT: As @Doo Doo mentioned
Hope you don't break any more rules, keep the server clean of that and hope you show us your positive side.
